cohort: 92,705 babies born at the study hospital between 2001 and 2016, with 384 diagnosed with possible lethal congenital malformations.
finding: A palliative care approach for fetuses with lethal congenital malformations, involving non-monitoring during pregnancy and avoiding cesarean section unless medically indicated, was ethically acceptable within the Islamic Code of Ethics and improved neonatal intensive care unit bed utilization.
